commitResults.messageBody:
Split the flat src/main/java class list into kiki, kiki.ui,
kiki.storage, kiki.parser, kiki.task, and kiki.exception packages,
grouped by responsibility, per the A-Packages requirement. Behaviour,
output, file format, and date/time handling are unchanged; only
package declarations, imports, and the README's run instructions
were updated to match.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add JUnit tests for core parsing and task-list logic
commitResults.messageBody:
Targets the ~50% coverage goal by testing the highest-value methods:
Parser's command parsing/validation, TaskList's add/remove/capacity
handling, and Kiki's date-range overlap/sort logic used by check
day/week (loosened from private to package-private for testability).
Trivial getters and I/O-heavy Storage/Ui methods are intentionally
left untested for now. Also documents the coverage target and the
requirement to keep tests updated after each change in AGENTS.md.

commitResults.messageTitle: Document how to build and run the fat JAR
commitResults.messageBody:
build.gradle already applies the shadowJar plugin with mainClass and
archiveFileName set correctly, so no build changes were needed. Add
README instructions for building the standalone kiki.jar and running
it with java -jar, so the existing shadowJar setup is discoverable.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add Javadoc comments to public classes and methods
commitResults.messageBody:
Coverage was at 23% (13/57 public elements), below the level's 50%
minimum. Add class-level and method-level Javadoc across Kiki, Ui,
Parser, Storage, TaskList, Task, ToDos, Deadlines, Events, and
KikiException, raising coverage to 73%. The remaining gaps are all
trivial one-line getters and toString() overrides, which the coding
standard explicitly exempts from requiring Javadoc.

commitResults.messageTitle: Add find command to search tasks by keyword
commitResults.messageBody: Co-Authored-By: Claude Sonnet 5 <noreply@anthropic.com>

# Conflicts:
#	src/main/java/kiki/parser/Parser.java

The TaskList methods already expect callers to validate capacity and indexes before mutating the backing array. These assertions document those internal assumptions and help catch programmer mistakes during development without replacing user-facing validation.

The storage parser previously validated the saved fields and constructed every task type in one method. Splitting task creation into smaller helpers keeps the storage format rules in parseSavedTask while moving deadline and event reconstruction into focused methods.

The find and date-check commands both build a list by scanning every task and keeping only matching items. Streams express that filter-and-collect flow directly, while preserving the existing sort step for dated tasks.

The extension lets users reorder their task list by date/time so scheduled work appears before undated todos. It reuses the existing date sort key, saves the reordered list, and documents the command in the README and UI test plan.
Add assertions to task list
Refactor saved task creation
Use streams for task filtering
Add sort command

commitResults.messageTitle: Improve GUI readability and error visibility
commitResults.messageBody: Distinguish user and Kiki messages and highlight command errors so conversations are easier to scan. Let message bubbles use the available window width instead of constraining them to a fixed size.
Integrate the clearer chat layout and command-error styling before the remaining Week 6 increments.

commitResults.messageTitle: Give Kiki a consistent task-assistant voice
commitResults.messageBody: Use clear, encouraging language throughout the conversation so the product feels cohesive and the user can understand task outcomes. Remove the obsolete listing-mode banner without changing command behavior.

commitResults.messageTitle: Reject invalid dates and malformed task commands
commitResults.messageBody: Parse calendar values strictly, reject repeated date markers, and prevent events whose start is not before their end. Report storage access failures clearly and skip invalid event rows loaded from disk.
Integrate stricter command validation and save-file error reporting before adding more regression coverage.

commitResults.messageTitle: Expand automated coverage for task workflows
commitResults.messageBody: Inject storage paths so persistence can be tested in isolated temporary directories. Keep the UI test plan aligned with the current greeting.
Replace the starter template with installation, command, date-format, task-status, and build instructions so the product is usable from its project website.
